primary.$description: Primary brand color used for main CTAs, links, and active states.

secondary.$description: Secondary brand color used for supporting actions.

accent.$description: Accent color used sparingly for highlights and promotional callouts.

success.$description: Indicates successful actions or positive status.

warning.$description: Indicates caution or a state requiring attention.

danger.$description: Indicates destructive actions or error states.

white.$description: Pure white, used for surfaces and inverted text.

gray-100.$description: Lightest neutral gray, used for page backgrounds.

gray-300.$description: Light gray, used for borders and dividers.

gray-500.$description: Mid gray, used for disabled text and placeholders.

gray-700.$description: Dark gray, used for secondary body text.

gray-900.$description: Darkest neutral, used for primary body text and headings.

black.$description: Pure black, used sparingly for maximum contrast needs.

muted.$description: Muted surface for cards and secondary panels.

inverse.$description: Text color used on dark/brand-colored backgrounds.
